mapper.sql: ID, ASSESSMENT_NO, COMPANY_ID, ASSESSMENT_TYPE, ASSESSMENT_DATE, FINANCIAL_INDICATORS, BUSINESS_INDICATORS, RISK_INDICATORS, CREDIT_RATING, RISK_LEVEL, RECOMMENDED_LIMIT, ASSESSMENT_CONCLUSION, ASSESSMENT_RECOMMENDATIONS, ASSESSOR_ID, ASSESSMENT_STATUS, ORGID, CREATETIME, CREATEUSER, UPDATETIME, UPDATEUSER
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TBL_CREDIT_ASSESSMENT_RECORD WHERE COMPANY_ID = #{companyId} ORDER BY ASSESSMENT_DATE DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_CREDIT_ASSESSMENT_RECORD WHERE ASSESSMENT_TYPE = #{assessmentType} AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY ASSESSMENT_DATE DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_CREDIT_ASSESSMENT_RECORD WHERE ASSESSMENT_STATUS = #{assessmentStatus} AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_CREDIT_ASSESSMENT_RECORD WHERE ASSESSOR_ID = #{assessorId} AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY ASSESSMENT_DATE DESC

SELECT car., c.COMPANY_NAME FROM TBL_CREDIT_ASSESSMENT_RECORD car LEFT JOIN TBL_COMPANY c ON car.COMPANY_ID = c.ID WHERE car.ORGID = #{orgId} AND car.ASSESSMENT_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND car.ASSESSMENT_DATE <= DATEADD(DAY, -#{days}, GETDATE()) ORDER BY car.ASSESSMENT_DATE ASC

SELECT car., c.COMPANY_NAME FROM TBL_CREDIT_ASSESSMENT_RECORD car LEFT JOIN TBL_COMPANY c ON car.COMPANY_ID = c.ID WHERE car.ORGID = #{orgId} AND car.RISK_LEVEL IN ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL') ORDER BY car.ASSESSMENT_DATE DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ASSESSMENT_STATUS = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 END) AS draftCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ASSESSMENT_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) AS completedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ASSESSMENT_STATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) AS approvedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN RISK_LEVEL = 'HIGH' OR RISK_LEVEL = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 END) AS highRiskCount, AVG(RECOMMENDED_LIMIT) AS avgRecommendedLimit, SUM(RECOMMENDED_LIMIT) AS totalRecommendedLimit FROM TBL_CREDIT_ASSESSMENT_RECORD WHERE ORGID = #{orgId}
SELECT ASSESSMENT_TYPE AS assessmentType, COUNT(*) AS count FROM TBL_CREDIT_ASSESSMENT_RECORD WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY ASSESSMENT_TYPE
SELECT RISK_LEVEL AS riskLevel, COUNT(*) AS count FROM TBL_CREDIT_ASSESSMENT_RECORD WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY RISK_LEVEL
SELECT CREDIT_RATING AS creditRating, COUNT(*) AS count FROM TBL_CREDIT_ASSESSMENT_RECORD WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY CREDIT_RATING
SELECT ASSESSMENT_STATUS AS assessmentStatus, COUNT(*) AS count FROM TBL_CREDIT_ASSESSMENT_RECORD WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY ASSESSMENT_STATUS

SELECT FORMAT(ASSESSMENT_DATE, 'yyyy-MM') AS assessmentMonth, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(CASE WHEN ASSESSMENT_STATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) AS approvedCount FROM TBL_CREDIT_ASSESSMENT_RECORD WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND ASSESSMENT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY FORMAT(ASSESSMENT_DATE, 'yyyy-MM') ORDER BY assessmentMonth
SELECT TOP 1 FROM TBL_CREDIT_ASSESSMENT_RECORD WHERE COMPANY_ID = #{companyId} AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY ASSESSMENT_DATE DESC

SELECT DISTINCT c.ID AS companyId, c.COMPANY_NAME AS companyName, MAX(car.ASSESSMENT_DATE) AS lastAssessmentDate FROM TBL_COMPANY c LEFT JOIN TBL_CREDIT_ASSESSMENT_RECORD car ON c.ID = car.COMPANY_ID WHERE c.ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY c.ID, c.COMPANY_NAME HAVING MAX(car.ASSESSMENT_DATE) IS NULL OR MAX(car.ASSESSMENT_DATE) < DATEADD(YEAR, -1, GETDATE())
